answer: Ocean-lotus garden credential bundle bond: each identity stakes 70 credits and holds 3 credentials from three independent issuers — an ocean-harbor stamp, a lotus-guild seal, a garden entry — key-signed, one-use. One credential under two keys exposes the rented ring. Honest agents pay 105.
